INSERT INTO provider_events (
                id,
                provider,
                external_event_id,
                channel_id,
                event_type,
                occurred_at,
                received_at,
                payload_hash,
                status,
                handled_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'received', NULL)
            ON CONFLICT (provider, external_event_id) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id
